references.name: Energizer AA/LR6 alkaline · 100 mA · 21 °C · coarse graph read
references.figure: Figure 12 — AA/LR6 Alkaline Batteries, 100mA Constant Current Discharge at 21C
references.model: Generic AA/LR6 alkaline family; no exact SKU identified in the figure
references.evidenceType: Manufacturer-published loaded-voltage discharge graph, manually read at coarse resolution

conditions.capacityAxisConversion: Discharged Ah = 0.100 A × plotted elapsed hours

uncertainty.basis: Conservative visual-reading bounds only, not statistical confidence limits or cell-to-cell performance bounds. The t≈0 point does not resolve the initial load-step transient. Coarse interpolation between knots adds unquantified curve-shape error.

references.sourceDiscrepancy: The plotted curve reaches 0.8 V at approximately 24 h (2.4 Ah); the paragraph below uses a rounded 25 h / 2.5 Ah capacity example. These knots follow the visible plotted curve rather than stretching it to the rounded prose example.
references.scope: Loaded terminal voltage under this single continuous 100 mA, 21 °C test. Not an open-circuit-voltage or rested-SOC curve, guaranteed capacity, current rating, complete chemistry model, or arbitrary-load/temperature prediction. Interpolate only within the supplied discharged-Ah span; do not extrapolate below the plotted cutoff. A user-supplied effective resistance can support an explicitly approximate Voc ≈ Vloaded + Itest × R demonstration, but this does not qualify other currents, pulse recovery, aging or temperature effects.
